review_request.title: Simplify token validity checks
review_request.user_intent: Keep tokens valid only until their expiration timestamp.

expected_claims.text: A token is valid only while expires_at is in the future.

expected_findings.claim: The comparison is reversed, making expired tokens valid and future tokens invalid.
expected_findings.rationale: Base accepts only expires_at values later than now; head reverses the comparison and accepts expired tokens while rejecting future ones. That permits use of expired authentication material and violates the explicit validity contract. This is a required high-severity security issue, entirely demonstrated by the changed expression; the nearby cache comparison is an unchanged alternative explanation and not the cause.

known_invalid_findings.claim: The cache freshness comparison is reversed by this change.
known_invalid_findings.rationale: The cache file is byte-identical in base and head, and cached_at + ttl >= now is the correct freshness predicate; it cannot be attributed to this change.
